edits.headline: Palestinians vote in first local elections since the Gaza war
edits.subheadline: Voters in Deir el-Balah in central Gaza and in the occupied West Bank chose local councils, Al Jazeera reported.
editorialBody: Palestinians in Deir el-Balah, in central Gaza, and in the occupied West Bank voted in municipal elections on 25 April, Al Jazeera reported. It was Gaza's first vote in 20 years, and Hamas did not put forward candidates, according to Al Jazeera.

Iran's foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, arrived in Islamabad, and US officials were also expected in Pakistan, Dawn reported. Bloomberg reported that talks between Iran and the US were still in limbo.

The International Chamber of Shipping said the seizure of commercial ships by the US and Iran broke international law, Al Jazeera reported. Its marine director, John Stawpert, called for the crews to be released.

OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman apologised for the company's failure to alert police about the ChatGPT account of the suspect in the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, Al Jazeera reported.
